user.title: Set up Budbee
user.description: Budbee tracking needs no account and no e-mail address — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `budbee.track_parcel` service.

data_description.add: Enter the Budbee tracking or order number to start tracking it. You find it in the shipping confirmation e-mail or on the tracking link the shop sent you. The e-mail address Budbee's own tracking page asks for is not needed here.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.refresh_interval: How often the integration checks Budbee for parcel updates. A slower interval is gentler on Budbee's API; the default of 30 minutes is plenty for most parcels.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Budbee tracking code.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Budbee tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Budbee tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Budbee tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
